articles.title_en: Emergence of information aggregation to rational expectations equilibria in markets populated by biased heuristic traders
articles.title_cn: 由有偏启发式交易者构成的市场中信息聚合向理性预期均衡的涌现
articles.abstract_en: Information aggregation is a key economic function of markets. We report results of a computational experiment with markets populated by simple algorithmic traders who follow two heuristics usually thought of as leading to biased information processing in behavioral economics literature (anchor-and-adjust, and representativeness). Outcomes of these markets either tend to cluster around (or fail to do so) rational expectations equilibria under specific conditions, consistent with markets populated by profit-motivated human traders. Algorithmic trader convergence is slower and noisier than that of human traders. Our results illustrate the emergence of rational expectations equilibria through complex interactions among actions of biased heuristic traders with limited information processing capabilities.
articles.abstract_cn: 信息聚合是市场的一个关键经济功能。我们报告了一个计算实验的结果，该实验的市场由简单的算法交易者构成，他们遵循行为经济学文献中通常被认为会导致有偏信息处理的两种启发式（锚定与调整，以及代表性）。这些市场的结果在特定条件下要么倾向于聚集在理性预期均衡周围（或未能如此），与由追求利润的人类交易者构成的市场一致。算法交易者的收敛速度比人类交易者更慢且噪声更大。我们的结果说明了通过具有有限信息处理能力的有偏启发式交易者行为之间的复杂交互，理性预期均衡的涌现。

articles.title_en: On the emergence of international currencies: An experimental approach
articles.title_cn: 论国际货币的出现：一种实验方法
articles.abstract_en: We integrate theory and experimental evidence to study the emergence of different international monetary arrangements based on the circulation of two intrinsically worthless fiat currencies as media of exchange. Our framework is based on a two-country, two-currency search model where the value of each currency is jointly determined by private agents’ decisions and monetary policy formalized as changes in a country’s money growth rate. Results from the experiments indicate subjects coordinate on a regime where both currencies are accepted even when other regimes are theoretically possible. At the same time, we find the acceptance of foreign currency depends on relative inflation rates where sellers tend to reject payment with a more inflationary foreign currency. We also document the presence of learning in shaping acceptance patterns over time.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们整合理论与实验证据，研究基于两种内在无价值的法定货币作为交换媒介流通的不同国际货币安排的出现。我们的框架基于一个两国、两货币的搜索模型，其中每种货币的价值由私人主体的决策和货币政策（以国家货币增长率的变化形式化）共同决定。实验结果表明，即使其他制度在理论上可能，受试者也会协调在两种货币都被接受的制度上。同时，我们发现外币的接受取决于相对通胀率，卖方倾向于拒绝接受通胀率更高的外币。我们还记录了学习在塑造随时间变化的接受模式中的作用。

articles.title_en: Backlash against expert recommendations: Reactions to COVID-19 advice in Latin America
articles.title_cn: 对专家建议的反弹：拉丁美洲对COVID-19建议的反应
articles.abstract_en: Public adherence with health recommendations is vital for effective crisis response. During the COVID-19 pandemic, governments faced considerable challenges in persuading the public to adopt new recommendations. Using large-scale survey experiments across 12 Latin American countries, we investigate how respondents’ agreement with health recommendations is affected by their attribution to experts from different sectors. Our results uncover a robust backlash against experts for pandemic-specific recommendations, but not for more general health advice. The backlash does not depend on the type of expert (academic, public or private sector). Our experimental setup allows us to concurrently assess the significance of different factors behind these results. Anti-intellectualism plays a role, since individuals with low initial trust in experts exhibit more negative reactions to expert attribution, although the backlash is also present for those with higher levels of trust, indicating that other factors likely play a role. We fail to find evidence that individual perceptions or personality traits such as social pressure, altruism or reactance contribute to the backlash. Beyond individual characteristics, we find that the backlash is stronger in countries that exhibited a more stringent government response to the pandemic.
articles.abstract_cn: 公众对健康建议的遵从对于有效的危机应对至关重要。在COVID-19大流行期间，政府在说服公众采纳新建议方面面临巨大挑战。通过在12个拉丁美洲国家进行的大规模调查实验，我们研究了受访者对健康建议的认同如何受到其归因于不同部门专家的影响。我们的结果揭示了对专家针对大流行特定建议的强烈反弹，但对更一般的健康建议则没有。这种反弹不取决于专家的类型（学术、公共或私营部门）。我们的实验设计使我们能够同时评估这些结果背后不同因素的重要性。反智主义发挥作用，因为对专家初始信任度低的个体对专家归因表现出更负面的反应，尽管对于信任度较高的个体也存在反弹，这表明其他因素可能也在起作用。我们未能找到证据表明个人感知或人格特质（如社会压力、利他主义或逆反心理）对反弹有贡献。除了个人特征之外，我们发现，在政府对大流行采取更严格应对措施的国家，反弹更为强烈。

articles.title_en: Moral bandwidth and environmental concerns during a public health crisis: Evidence from Germany
articles.title_cn: 公共卫生危机期间的道德带宽与环境关注：来自德国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Did the COVID-19 pandemic crowd out environmental concerns, as one might expect if “pools of worry” were finite or “moral bandwidth” was limited? We use Chancellor Angela Merkel’s address to the German nation on 18 March 2020 as the threshold in a regression discontinuity in time (RDiT) to evaluate the effects of an increase in COVID-based economic and health concerns on the climate and environmental concerns of respondents to the German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP). We find no evidence of crowding out – there is even some indication that environmental concerns increased, especially on the intensive margin – and show that this result survives various robustness checks. We also share some evidence that the treatment effects are heterogeneous: the concerns of older and more patient Germans, as well as those who report more social trust, increased relative to other groups. This is consistent with the absence of bandwidth constraints, but other interpretations – hierarchical or complementary concerns, for example – are also possible.
articles.abstract_cn: COVID-19疫情是否挤出了环境关注，正如人们可能预期的那样，如果“担忧池”是有限的或“道德带宽”是有限的？我们使用德国总理安格拉·默克尔于18 三月 2020向德国国民发表的讲话作为时间回归不连续设计（RDiT）中的阈值，以评估COVID相关的经济与健康关注的增加对德国社会经济面板（SOEP）受访者气候与环境关注的影响。我们没有发现挤出效应的证据——甚至有一些迹象表明环境关注有所增加，尤其是在集约边际上——并表明这一结果在各种稳健性检验中依然成立。我们还分享了一些证据表明处理效应具有异质性：年长且更有耐心的德国人，以及那些报告更多社会信任的人，其关注相对于其他群体有所增加。这与不存在带宽约束的情况一致，但其他解释——例如层级关注或互补关注——也是可能的。

articles.title_en: People do not demand commitment devices because they might not work
articles.title_cn: 人们不需求承诺装置是因为它们可能不起作用
articles.abstract_en: Low demand for pure commitment in real markets presents a puzzle. A possible explanation is that individuals are unaware of their present bias and their need for commitment. I test the relationship between perceived intertemporal inconsistency and demand for commitment in a novel context, volunteering. I run an experiment that successfully corrects subjects’ beliefs about their present bias and find that this increased awareness does not increase demand for commitment. This low demand for commitment is not driven by a perceived lack of present bias, but rather subjects’ accurate belief that they may fail to follow through, even with the offered level of commitment.
articles.abstract_cn: 真实市场中纯承诺的低需求构成一个谜题。一个可能的解释是，个体没有意识到自己的现时偏差和对承诺的需求。我在一个新颖的情境——志愿服务中，检验了感知的跨期不一致性与承诺需求之间的关系。我进行了一项实验，成功纠正了被试关于自身现时偏差的信念，并发现这种增强的意识并未增加对承诺的需求。这种低承诺需求并非由感知到的现时偏差缺失所驱动，而是源于被试准确相信，即使提供了所承诺的承诺水平，他们也可能无法坚持到底。

articles.title_en: Analysts’ accuracy following an increase in uncertainty: Evidence from the art market
articles.title_cn: 不确定性增加后分析师的准确性：来自艺术品市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study utilizes the art market as an exogenous setting to explore how an increase in price uncertainty (i.e., the death of an artist) impacts the accuracy and forecast error of analysts’ estimates. We find that in the year following an artist's death, analysts’ accuracy decreases by 14% and their forecast error increases by 11%. Additional analysis indicates that the effect is due to a decrease in the estimation range, an increase in the forecast bias of analysts, and an increase in the price volatility of the artwork. These findings suggest that analysts perform poorly following an increase in uncertainty which is pertinent for asset markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用艺术品市场作为外生环境，探讨价格不确定性增加（即艺术家去世）如何影响分析师估计的准确性和预测误差。我们发现，在艺术家去世后的一年中，分析师的准确性下降了14%，预测误差增加了11%。进一步分析表明，这种效应是由于估计范围的缩小、分析师预测偏差的增加以及艺术品价格波动的增加所致。这些发现表明，在不确定性增加后，分析师表现不佳，这对资产市场具有重要意义。

articles.title_en: Productivity performance, distance to frontier and AI innovation: Firm-level evidence from Europe
articles.title_cn: 生产率表现、前沿距离与人工智能创新：来自欧洲的企业层面证据
articles.abstract_en: Using firm-level data from 15 European countries between 2011 and 2019, this paper examines the productivity effect associated with the development of Artificial Intelligence (AI), measured by patenting success in AI fields. By making advances in AI and expanding on their knowledge base, companies can optimise production tasks, and improve resource utilisation, ultimately leading to higher levels of efficiency. To investigate this, we develop a two-fold panel regression analysis estimated within a Difference-in-Differences (DiD) framework. First, we investigate whether firms that engage in AI innovation experience a productivity boost after developing the new technology, compared to similar firms which do not undertake AI innovation. To analyse this, we employ a novel event-analysis methodology that quantifies the effect of the treatment (AI innovation) on firm performance (productivity) using a Local Projections approach within the DiD setting. Second, we utilise a Distance-to-Frontier (DTF) regression framework in order to examine whether the productivity premium of AI is associated with a firm’s ability to absorb knowledge and learn from the technologies developed by market leaders. Our findings reveal that the productivity gains directly associated with AI are statistically significant and quantitatively important, ranging between 6.2 and 17% in the event analysis, and between 2.1 and 6% in the DTF framework. We also provide some evidence that the productivity benefits of AI might be greater for those firms further away from the frontier (between 0.3 and 0.7%). Our research demonstrates that Artificial Intelligence can play a crucial role in enhancing firm productivity in Europe, a result that is evident even in these early stages of the technology’s life cycle.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用15年至2011年间2019个欧洲国家的企业层面数据，本文考察了人工智能（AI）发展（以AI领域的专利成功衡量）所带来的生产率效应。通过推进AI并扩展其知识基础，企业可以优化生产任务，提高资源利用率，最终实现更高水平的效率。为探究这一问题，我们构建了一个在双重差分（DiD）框架内估计的双重面板回归分析。首先，我们考察与未进行AI创新的类似企业相比，从事AI创新的企业在开发新技术后是否经历了生产率提升。为此，我们采用一种新颖的事件分析方法，该方法在DiD设定内使用局部投影方法量化处理（AI创新）对企业绩效（生产率）的影响。其次，我们利用前沿距离（DTF）回归框架，检验AI的生产率溢价是否与企业吸收知识并向市场领导者开发的技术学习的能力相关。我们的研究结果显示，与AI直接相关的生产率提升在统计上显著且数量上重要，在事件分析中介于6.2至17%之间，在DTF框架中介于2.1至6%之间。我们还提供了一些证据表明，对于远离前沿的企业，AI的生产率收益可能更大（介于0.3至0.7%之间）。我们的研究表明，人工智能在提升欧洲企业生产率方面可以发挥关键作用，这一结果即使在技术生命周期的早期阶段也是显而易见的。

articles.title_en: Sharing the cake during a crisis: The impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on intertemporal altruism and efficiency concerns
articles.title_cn: 危机期间分蛋糕：COVID-19疫情对跨期利他主义和效率关注的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study examines inter-temporal distribution decisions on private payments and donations during the coronavirus pandemic. We simultaneously measured individual efficiency concerns, altruism and time preferences in an online experiment conducted among US residents during different stages of the crisis. Participants were asked to distribute money between different dates and recipients, that is, today versus in two weeks and private payouts versus donations to fight against the pandemic. To assess participants’ affectedness by COVID-19, we collected data on participants’ employment status and financial situation, as well as their individual vulnerability to COVID-19. We identify a decrease in individual preferences for efficiency over the progress of the pandemic. The reduction of efficiency concerns is driven by self-reported financial affectedness, but accompanied by an increase in altruism. Our results point at the crucial role of financial security for both efficiency-seeking behaviour and the willingness to provide support during the crisis.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了在冠状病毒疫情期间，私人支付和捐赠的跨期分配决策。我们在危机的不同阶段，对美国居民进行了一项在线实验，同时测量了个体的效率关注、利他主义和时间偏好。参与者被要求在两个日期和不同收款人之间分配资金，即今天与两周后，以及私人支付与用于抗击疫情的捐赠。为了评估参与者受COVID-19影响的程度，我们收集了参与者的就业状况、财务状况以及他们对COVID-19的个人脆弱性数据。我们发现，随着疫情的进展，个体对效率的偏好有所下降。效率关注的减少是由自我报告的财务受影响程度驱动的，但伴随着利他主义的增加。我们的结果指出了财务安全在危机期间对效率寻求行为和提供支持意愿的关键作用。

articles.title_en: Highway havens for hidden horrors: Expressway connections and child trafficking in China
articles.title_cn: 高速公路下的隐秘恐怖：高速公路连接与中国儿童拐卖
articles.abstract_en: Child trafficking is a deep-seated social issue with enduring consequences that remain concealed or less obvious to the general public. We argue that the intensity of child trafficking increases as an indirect and unintended consequence of improved urban infrastructure, such as the construction of highways that facilitate the expedient transfer of victims between cities. To establish a causal relationship, we analyze data on child abduction and combine it with geo-referenced information on China’s highway routes. Using a staggered difference-in-differences approach and a city-to-city analysis, we find that the construction of highways in a city significantly leads to an increase in abducted children. Changes in both demand and supply factors following the highway construction could explain the increase in child trafficking.
articles.abstract_cn: 儿童拐卖是一个根深蒂固的社会问题，其持久后果对公众而言往往隐蔽或不太明显。我们认为，儿童拐卖的强度随着城市基础设施改善（如高速公路建设便利了受害者城市间的快速转移）而增加，这是一种间接且非预期的后果。为建立因果关系，我们分析了儿童绑架数据，并将其与中国高速公路路线的地理参考信息相结合。采用交错双重差分法和城市间分析，我们发现城市高速公路的建设显著导致被绑架儿童数量的增加。高速公路建设后供需因素的变化可以解释儿童拐卖的增加。

articles.title_en: Local far-right demonstrations and nationwide public attitudes towards migration
articles.title_cn: 地方极右翼示威与全国公众对移民的态度
articles.abstract_en: One of the primary objectives of protests and demonstrations is to bring social, political, or economic issues to the attention of politicians and the wider population. While protests can have a mobilising and persuading effect, they may reduce support for their cause if they are perceived as a threat to public order. In this study, we look at how local or spontaneously organised right-wing xenophobic demonstrations affect concerns about hostility towards foreigners and worries about immigration among natives in Germany. We use a regression discontinuity design to compare the attitudes of individuals interviewed in the days immediately before a large far-right demonstration and individuals interviewed in the days immediately after that demonstration. Our results show that large far-right demonstrations lead to a substantial increase in worries about hostility towards foreigners of 13.7% of a standard deviation. In contrast, worries about immigration are not affected by the demonstrations, indicating that the protesters are not successful in swaying public opinion in their favour. In the heterogeneity analyses, we uncover some polarisation in the population: While worries about hostility against foreigners increase and worries about immigration decrease in left-leaning regions, both types of worries increase in districts where centre-right parties are more successful. Lastly, we also show that people become more politically interested in response to protests, mainly benefiting left-wing parties, and are more likely to wish to donate money to help refugees.
articles.abstract_cn: 抗议和示威的主要目标之一是将社会、政治或经济问题提请政治家和更广泛民众的关注。虽然抗议可以产生动员和说服效果，但如果被视为对公共秩序的威胁，它们可能会减少对其事业的支持。在本研究中，我们考察了地方性或自发组织的右翼仇外示威如何影响德国本地人对针对外国人的敌意以及移民问题的担忧。我们使用断点回归设计来比较在大型极右翼示威前几天接受采访的个体与在示威后几天接受采访的个体的态度。我们的结果表明，大型极右翼示威导致对针对外国人的敌意的担忧显著增加，增幅为标准差的13.7%。相比之下，对移民问题的担忧不受示威影响，表明抗议者未能成功地将公众舆论转向有利于他们的方向。在异质性分析中，我们发现了人口中的一些两极分化：在左倾地区，对针对外国人的敌意的担忧增加，而对移民问题的担忧减少；而在中右翼政党更为成功的地区，两类担忧均增加。最后，我们还表明，人们因抗议而变得更加政治感兴趣，这主要有利于左翼政党，并且更有可能希望捐款帮助难民。

articles.title_en: Who is to suffer? Quantifying the impact of sanctions on German firms
articles.title_cn: 谁将受损？量化制裁对德国企业的影响
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we use a novel firm level dataset for Germany to investigate the effect of sanctions on export behaviour and performance of German firms. More specifically, we study the sanctions imposed by the EU against Russia in 2014 in response to the annexation of Crimea and Russia’s countermeasures. We find a substantial negative effect on both the extensive and intensive margin of German exports. While the negative effects are strongest for firms exporting products subject to trade restrictions, we provide further evidence on the indirect effects of sanctions. Analysing the impact on broader measures of firm performance, we document that the cost of sanctions is heterogeneous across firms but overall modest. Our results reveal that the negative impact of the shock was concentrated primarily among a small number of firms that were highly dependent on Russia as an export market and those directly affected by the sanctions.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们使用一个新颖的德国企业层面数据集来研究制裁对德国企业出口行为和绩效的影响。更具体地说，我们研究了欧盟因2014年克里米亚吞并事件而对俄罗斯实施的制裁以及俄罗斯的反制措施。我们发现制裁对德国出口的广延边际和集约边际均产生了显著的负面影响。虽然负面效应在出口受贸易限制产品的企业中最为强烈，但我们进一步提供了制裁间接效应的证据。通过分析对企业绩效更广泛指标的影响，我们记录了制裁成本在企业间存在异质性，但总体而言较为温和。我们的结果表明，冲击的负面影响主要集中在少数高度依赖俄罗斯作为出口市场以及直接受制裁影响的企业中。

articles.title_en: Not all about the money: Service quality information improves consumer decision-making
articles.title_cn: 并非全是钱的问题：服务质量信息改善消费者决策
articles.abstract_en: Information asymmetries are pervasive in many industries and can result in large losses in consumer welfare. Does providing product quality information result in improved consumer decision-making? We study this question in a market where quality is notoriously hard to determine ex ante: the residential energy market. Using a discrete choice experiment (N = 1,002), we document a substantial willingness-to-pay (37–45 % of the median bill) for four service quality attributes (transparency, agency, authenticity, and convenience). In an incentivized search task (N = 432), we show that how quality information is presented matters: consumers who view information in the form of ratings and stamps of approval are (i) 4 % more likely to opt in to the search task, and (ii) 20 % more likely to correctly identify given levels of quality, relative to consumers who are provided with bar graphs, pie charts, and text. Finally, using a decision experiment (N = 510) with real company names familiar to our participants, we find that the provision of quality information increases choices of the best-rated company more than 20-fold, relative to the control scenario where quality information is absent, in which consumers select companies predominantly on price and brand awareness. Our findings are applicable to other markets in which information asymmetries are present, where policymakers should consider interventions that promote transparency and quality information provision.
articles.abstract_cn: 信息不对称在许多行业中普遍存在，可能导致消费者福利的巨大损失。提供产品质量信息是否能改善消费者的决策？我们在一个质量事前难以确定的市场中研究这一问题：住宅能源市场。通过一项离散选择实验（N = 1,002），我们记录了消费者对四个服务质量属性（透明度、代理性、真实性和便利性）的显著支付意愿（占中位数账单的37-45%）。在一项激励性搜索任务（N = 432）中，我们表明质量信息的呈现方式很重要：与提供条形图、饼图和文本的消费者相比，以评级和批准印章形式查看信息的消费者（i）选择参与搜索任务的可能性高4%，（ii）正确识别给定质量水平的可能性高20%。最后，使用一项包含参与者熟悉的真实公司名称的决策实验（N = 510），我们发现，相对于没有质量信息的控制情景（消费者主要根据价格和品牌知名度选择公司），提供质量信息使选择最佳评级公司的可能性增加了20倍以上。我们的发现适用于其他存在信息不对称的市场，政策制定者应考虑促进透明度和质量信息提供的干预措施。

articles.title_en: Precautionary saving under recursive preferences
articles.title_cn: 递归偏好下的预防性储蓄
articles.abstract_en: The preferences responsible for precautionary saving under recursive utility can be decomposed into two channels. One exactly mirrors expected utility, while the other is unique to recursive utility. Although these channels contain numerous competing saving effects, theoretical and numerical comparative statics point to some generalizable features. Risk preferences drive most of precautionary saving, and they are the only higher-order preferences ever expressed. But, plain 2nd-order intertemporal preferences (consumption smoothing) influence total saving far more than any other kind of preference. Precautionary responses to risks beyond 2nd order are minimal. Responses to return risk are typically negative.
articles.abstract_cn: 递归效用下产生预防性储蓄的偏好可以分解为两个渠道。一个渠道与期望效用完全一致，而另一个渠道则是递归效用所独有的。尽管这些渠道包含众多相互竞争的储蓄效应，但理论和数值比较静态分析指向了一些可概括的特征。风险偏好驱动了大部分预防性储蓄，并且它们是唯一被表达的高阶偏好。但是，普通的2阶跨期偏好（消费平滑）对总储蓄的影响远大于任何其他类型的偏好。对超出2阶风险的风险的预防性反应微乎其微。对回报风险的反应通常是负的。

articles.title_en: The educational and labor market consequences of teenage exposure to rural land decollectivization in China
articles.title_cn: 中国农村土地非集体化对青少年教育及劳动力市场后果的影响
articles.abstract_en: China's land decollectivization reform implemented around 1980 expanded the agricultural and nonagricultural sectors in rural areas and thereby increased the opportunity cost of schooling for teenagers. Combining the staggered adoption of the reform across regions with individual life history data, we show that teenagers substituted out of school and into agricultural and nonagricultural work following the reform. Using population census data, we further show that teenage exposure to the reform reduced the probability of completing high school by 2.0–2.2 percentage points, the probability of nonagricultural employment by 1.5–1.6 percentage points, and income by 3.6–4.7 percent.
articles.abstract_cn: 中国约在1980年实施的土地非集体化改革扩大了农村地区的农业和非农业部门，从而提高了青少年上学的机会成本。结合各地区改革实施时间的差异与个人生活史数据，我们显示改革后青少年从学校转向农业和非农业工作。利用人口普查数据，我们进一步显示青少年时期接触改革使完成高中教育的概率降低了2.0-2.2个百分点，非农业就业的概率降低了1.5-1.6个百分点，收入降低了3.6-4.7%。

articles.title_en: Revenue sharing agreements and hold-up problems in joint projects: Theory and experiments
articles.title_cn: 联合项目中的收益分享协议与套牢问题：理论与实验
articles.abstract_en: The lack of property rights in joint projects can cause hold-up problems, as expected fights over the proceeds make investing not worthwhile. We investigate theoretically and experimentally if the availability of different contractual sharing rules can solve the hold-up problem. As theory predicts, we find that the availability of first-best contracts that divide revenue proportional to investment shares yields high uptake, extensive investment and high efficiency. First-best sharing contracts are often not feasible. Simple equal-split contracts are a prominent but theoretically ineffective alternative. Contrary to theoretical predictions, making cheap equal-split contracts available is welfare increasing. Cooperative participants opt for the contract with the correct expectation that despite the lack of incentives significant investment will follow. This leads to welfare gains. The better than expected performance of equal-split contracts provides a rationale for their frequent use in the field.
articles.abstract_cn: 联合项目中产权缺失可能导致套牢问题，因为对收益的预期争夺使得投资变得不值得。我们从理论和实验上研究不同契约性分享规则的可用性是否能解决套牢问题。正如理论所预测的，我们发现，按投资份额比例分配收益的最优契约的可用性带来了高采纳率、广泛投资和高效率。最优分享契约往往不可行。简单的均分契约是一种突出但理论上无效的替代方案。与理论预测相反，提供廉价的均分契约能提高福利。合作参与者选择该契约，并正确预期到尽管缺乏激励，重大投资仍将随之而来。这带来了福利收益。均分契约的表现优于预期，为其在实践中的频繁使用提供了理由。

articles.title_en: Dissecting environmental efficiency: The role of technology adoption and usage
articles.title_cn: 解析环境效率：技术采用与使用的角色
articles.abstract_en: How could firms best reduce their environmental impact? Should they change technology? Or could they do better with what they already have? This paper shows that one size does not fit all. We analyse a sample of polluting production plants (i.e. installations) regulated under the EU Emission Trading System. We employ a mixture model estimation to dissect environmental efficiency into a technology adoption component (what type of technology is used) and a technology usage component (how a technology is used). Our installation-level analysis shows that the share of installations adopting frontier technologies is about 21%. We also find that the average environmental efficiency gains that installations could reach by improving technology adoption and technology usage are 75% and 80% respectively. The analysis of balance-sheet data on parent companies reveals that better environmental technologies are adopted by larger, listed, multi-installation and international companies, while older firms and firms with higher intangible assets intensity more commonly show improved technology usage.
articles.abstract_cn: 企业如何最好地减少其环境影响？他们应该改变技术吗？还是他们可以用已有的技术做得更好？本文表明，一刀切的做法并不适用。我们分析了欧盟排放交易体系监管下的污染生产工厂（即装置）样本。我们采用混合模型估计，将环境效率分解为技术采用成分（使用何种类型的技术）和技术使用成分（如何使用技术）。我们的装置层面分析显示，采用前沿技术的装置比例约为21%。我们还发现，装置通过改进技术采用和技术使用所能达到的平均环境效率增益分别为75%和80%。对母公司资产负债表数据的分析显示，更好的环境技术被规模更大、上市、多装置和国际化的公司所采用，而较老的公司和无形资产密集度较高的公司更常见地表现出改进的技术使用。

articles.title_en: Sustainability in the wake of crisis: Transforming climate change-induced disasters into drivers of renewable energy innovation in business
articles.title_cn: 危机后的可持续性：将气候变化引发的灾害转化为企业可再生能源创新的驱动力
articles.abstract_en: This study examines how climate change-induced disasters affect renewable energy innovation in United States-based firms. To this end, we utilized the behavioral theory of the firm and the threat rigidity model to investigate strategic decision-making in the context of environmental crises. We employed a difference-in-differences approach combined with meta-analysis. Further, we analyzed data from 2013 to 2018 and found a significant increase in renewable energy innovation following climatological disasters, marked by an effect size of 0.74. However, firms exceeding their aspiration levels exhibit a smaller impact, reducing the effect on renewable energy innovation by 0.273 units. Additionally, firms with a frequent history of climatological disasters showed a decrease in renewable energy innovation, with an effect size of -0.349. Our research contributes to green innovation literature, particularly to renewable energy innovation discourse under climate challenges. It extends the behavioral theory of the firm to contexts of climatic uncertainty and applies the threat rigidity model to determine organizational adaptation. The study introduces a novel moderator: the firm's history of natural disasters, linking firm age with disaster frequency and severity. These insights are vital for enhancing strategic decision-making in the business and policy-making contexts, amidst the growing climate change challenges.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了气候变化引发的灾害如何影响美国企业的可再生能源创新。为此，我们利用企业行为理论和威胁刚性模型来调查环境危机背景下的战略决策。我们采用了双重差分法结合元分析。此外，我们分析了2013年至2018年的数据，发现气候灾害后可再生能源创新显著增加，效应量为0.74。然而，超过期望水平的企业影响较小，将可再生能源创新的效应减少了0.273个单位。此外，频繁经历气候灾害的企业显示可再生能源创新减少，效应量为-0.349。我们的研究为绿色创新文献做出了贡献，特别是在气候挑战下的可再生能源创新讨论中。它将企业行为理论扩展到气候不确定性情境，并应用威胁刚性模型来确定组织适应性。该研究引入了一个新的调节变量：企业的自然灾害历史，将企业年龄与灾害频率和严重程度联系起来。这些见解对于在日益增长的气候变化挑战中加强企业和政策制定背景下的战略决策至关重要。

articles.title_en: Ambiguity attitudes and surprises: Experimental evidence on communicating new information within a large population sample
articles.title_cn: 模糊态度与意外信息：在大规模人口样本中传达新信息的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates ambiguity attitudes for natural events (temperatures) and how they are updated following new information. Using a general population sample, we first obtain baseline ambiguity attitudes for future weather events based on real temperatures over several past days. Second, we study the influence of different communication types on updating the ambiguity attitudes: participants are given either point estimators, interval estimators, or the combination of both as weather forecasts. We further vary whether the forecast is surprising or in line with the initially received information. In contrast to claims that ambiguity aversion may increase in response to surprising news, we find that ambiguity attitudes are rather robust to new information and variants of their communication. Yet, different variants of communicating new information significantly change the belief updating process and affect the matching probabilities given to specific events. Our sample allows us to analyze socio-demographic correlates of ambiguity attitudes and the updating of ambiguity attitudes to new information.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了自然事件（温度）的模糊态度以及在新信息后如何更新这些态度。使用一般人口样本，我们首先基于过去几天的实际温度获得对未来天气事件的基线模糊态度。其次，我们研究不同沟通类型对更新模糊态度的影响：参与者被给予点估计、区间估计或两者组合作为天气预报。我们进一步变化预报是令人意外的还是与最初收到的信息一致。与声称模糊厌恶可能因意外消息而增加的观点相反，我们发现模糊态度对新信息及其沟通变体相当稳健。然而，不同沟通新信息的变体显著改变了信念更新过程，并影响了对特定事件给出的匹配概率。我们的样本使我们能够分析模糊态度的社会人口学相关性以及模糊态度对新信息的更新。

articles.title_en: Information nudges and tax compliance: Evidence from a field experiment in China
articles.title_cn: 信息助推与税收遵从：来自中国实地实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Tax administrations worldwide employ various policy tools to enhance tax compliance, but the effectiveness of nudges remains uncertain. To address this gap, we conducted a field experiment in China to evaluate the causal effects of deterrence and non-deterrence nudges on individual income tax compliance. Our findings indicate that all reminder messages significantly increase tax compliance compared to a no-message control group. Furthermore, when compared to a basic information control group, deterrence nudges – such as those highlighting credit penalties and overdue fines – significantly boost tax compliance, while non-deterrence nudges, such as appeals to tax morality or public services, have an insignificant impact. Deterrence nudges also show heterogeneous effects on tax compliance, being primarily short-term with diminishing influence over time. They are particularly effective in motivating males and individuals in market sectors to comply, but fail to improve compliance among firm owners and the super-rich.
articles.abstract_cn: 世界各地的税务机关采用各种政策工具来提高税收遵从度，但助推的有效性仍不确定。为弥补这一空白，我们在中国进行了一项实地实验，以评估威慑性和非威慑性助推对个人所得税遵从的因果效应。我们的研究结果表明，与无信息对照组相比，所有提醒信息均显著提高了税收遵从度。此外，与基本信息对照组相比，威慑性助推——例如强调信用处罚和逾期罚款的信息——显著提高了税收遵从度，而非威慑性助推，如诉诸税收道德或公共服务的信息，则影响不显著。威慑性助推对税收遵从还表现出异质性效应，主要体现为短期效应，随时间推移影响力减弱。它们特别能有效激励男性和市场部门个体遵从，但未能改善企业主和超级富豪的遵从度。

articles.title_en: Information about inequality in early child care reduces polarization in policy preferences
articles.title_cn: 关于早期儿童保育不平等的信息减少了政策偏好的极化
articles.abstract_en: We investigate public preferences for equity-enhancing policies in access to early child care, using a survey experiment with a representative sample of the German population (n≈4,800). We observe strong misperceptions about migrant-native inequalities in early child care that vary by respondents’ age and right-wing voting preferences. Randomly providing information about the actual extent of inequalities has a nuanced impact on the support for equity-enhancing policy reforms: it increases support for respondents who initially underestimated these inequalities, and tends to decrease support for those who initially overestimated them. This asymmetric effect leads to a more consensual policy view, substantially decreasing the polarization in policy support between under- and overestimators. Our results suggest that correcting misperceptions can align public policy preferences, potentially leading to less polarized debates about how to address inequalities and discrimination.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过一项对德国人口代表性样本（n≈4,800）的调查实验，研究了公众对早期儿童保育获取中促进公平政策的偏好。我们观察到关于移民与本地人在早期儿童保育方面不平等的强烈误解，这些误解因受访者的年龄和右翼投票偏好而异。随机提供关于不平等实际程度的信息对支持促进公平政策改革产生了细微的影响：它增加了最初低估这些不平等的受访者的支持，并倾向于减少最初高估这些不平等的受访者的支持。这种不对称效应导致了更一致的政策观点，显著减少了低估者与高估者之间在政策支持上的极化。我们的结果表明，纠正误解可以协调公共政策偏好，可能减少关于如何解决不平等和歧视的极化辩论。

articles.title_en: Are women blamed more for giving incorrect financial advice?
articles.title_cn: 女性因提供错误财务建议而受到更多指责吗？
articles.abstract_en: We conduct an incentivized experiment with a nationally representative sample to investigate gender discrimination among people receiving advice on risky investments. Participants learn about actual start-up firms they can invest in. Before deciding how much of their endowment to invest, they receive recommendations from either female or male professionals. We find that before outcomes are revealed, participants are equally likely to follow recommendations of female and male advisors. Likewise, we observe no gender discrimination following advice that proves correct. However, for advice that turns out to be incorrect, advisor gender significantly impacts the decisions made by male participants. They invest 47% less in the direction of this advice compared to situations where male advisors were incorrect. These differences are not explained by participants’ stated views on gender roles and advisors’ ability as well as the level of attention towards female advisors.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用具有全国代表性的样本进行了一项激励实验，以调查接受风险投资建议的人群中的性别歧视。参与者了解他们可以投资的实际初创企业。在决定投入多少资金之前，他们会收到来自女性或男性专业人士的建议。我们发现，在结果揭晓之前，参与者同样可能遵循女性和男性顾问的建议。同样，在建议被证明正确后，我们也没有观察到性别歧视。然而，对于被证明不正确的建议，顾问的性别显著影响男性参与者做出的决策。与男性顾问提供错误建议的情况相比，他们在这类建议方向上的投资减少了47%。这些差异并不能由参与者对性别角色的陈述观点、顾问的能力以及对女性顾问的关注程度来解释。

articles.title_en: Unintended consequences of maternity leave entitlements on female labor market outcomes in China
articles.title_cn: 产假权利对中国女性劳动力市场结果的意外后果
articles.abstract_en: This study provides the first empirical evidence of the impact of maternity leave entitlements on labor market outcomes for women of childbearing age in urban China. We exploit a reform during which approximately two-thirds of the provinces in China extended their leave entitlements from 2014 to 2016 and employ a triple-difference strategy to deal with the identification. The results suggest unintended effects, as leave entitlement extensions led to a reduction in the likelihood of working, formal employment, and wage for women of childbearing age relative to their counterparts. We further establish that greater reliance on employer liability may be the main mechanism behind the unintended effects, highlighting the importance of payment schemes. This study provides novel evidence and mechanisms for the labor market effect of maternity leave in women of childbearing age and provides new insights for maternity leave related policy designs.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究首次提供了产假权利对中国城市育龄女性劳动力市场结果影响的实证证据。我们利用了一项改革，在此期间中国约三分之二的省份在2014年至2016年间延长了产假权利，并采用三重差分策略来处理识别问题。结果表明存在意外效应，因为产假延长导致育龄女性相对于其对照组的工作可能性、正规就业和工资下降。我们进一步证实，对雇主责任的更大依赖可能是意外效应背后的主要机制，凸显了支付方案的重要性。本研究为产假对育龄女性劳动力市场影响提供了新的证据和机制，并为产假相关政策设计提供了新见解。

articles.title_en: Think twice before attacking: Effort, restraint, and sanctions in war conflicts
articles.title_cn: 攻击前三思：战争冲突中的努力、克制与制裁
articles.abstract_en: There are contrasting empirical findings about how third parties mitigate conflict and few theoretical results about war efforts and restraint. Applying a new approach that distinguishes between quantity and effectiveness of effort, we explain countries’ restraint incentives. In our setting, restraint is manifested in reducing the effectiveness of military efforts when third parties impose costs (sanctions) on unrestrained behavior. We show that intermediate sanctions may lead to a mixed-strategy equilibrium or pure strategy equilibria in which only one country reduces its effectiveness. We present the conditions that yield pure-strategy (in which, surprisingly, restraint is a corner solution) and mixed-strategy (MS) equilibria in our multi-stage model. Interestingly, a country's effort decreases with its or its rival's self-restraint, allowing a third party to reduce efforts by sanctioning only one country. Our analysis enriches the classical results, particularly those obtained in the context of war conflicts, which focus on the extent of effort expended and on means of mitigating the conflict. The theoretical study lays the groundwork for future research into war contests and suggests various avenues for further exploration.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于第三方如何缓解冲突的实证研究结果存在对比，而关于战争努力和克制的理论结果则较少。通过采用一种区分努力数量与有效性的新方法，我们解释了各国的克制激励。在我们的设定中，当第三方对不克制行为施加成本（制裁）时，克制表现为降低军事努力的有效性。我们表明，中等程度的制裁可能导致混合策略均衡或纯策略均衡，其中只有一国降低其有效性。我们给出了在多阶段模型中产生纯策略（令人惊讶的是，克制是角点解）和混合策略（MS）均衡的条件。有趣的是，一国的努力随其自身或对手的克制而减少，这使得第三方可以通过仅制裁一国来减少努力。我们的分析丰富了经典结果，特别是在战争冲突背景下获得的那些结果，这些结果侧重于努力投入的程度和缓解冲突的手段。这项理论研究为未来战争竞赛的研究奠定了基础，并提出了进一步探索的各种途径。

articles.title_en: Pension systems revisited in the age of automation and an aging economy
articles.title_cn: 自动化与老龄化经济中的养老金制度再探讨
articles.abstract_en: This study analyzes the impact of aging — an increase in longevity or a decrease in fertility rates — on pension benefits in an economy that incorporates automation capital in the production process. Across all three pension schemes—pay as you go, fully funded, and modified fully funded, we observe that the impact of increasing longevity is more pronounced than that of a decreasing fertility rate. Specifically, our analyses indicate that while increasing longevity consistently has a negative impact on pension benefits under all pension schemes, the impact of a decreasing fertility rate varies according to the pension scheme. Additionally, based on the common observation across all pension schemes that low-skilled households are vulnerable to the impacts of aging, we explore redistributive policies to improve the welfare of these households, and our findings indicate that the policy that leads to Pareto improvement can vary depending on the main driver of demographic transitions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了在将自动化资本纳入生产过程的经济中，老龄化（即寿命延长或生育率下降）对养老金福利的影响。在所有三种养老金计划——现收现付制、完全积累制和修正的完全积累制下，我们观察到寿命延长的影响比生育率下降的影响更为显著。具体而言，我们的分析表明，虽然寿命延长在所有养老金计划下始终对养老金福利产生负面影响，但生育率下降的影响则因养老金计划而异。此外，基于所有养老金计划中低技能家庭易受老龄化影响的共同观察，我们探讨了旨在改善这些家庭福利的再分配政策，我们的研究结果表明，能够实现帕累托改进的政策可能因人口转变的主要驱动因素而异。

articles.title_en: Impact of fundamentalism on human capital, women's social status and demographics: Evidence from Islamic state of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) in Iraq
articles.title_cn: 原教旨主义对人力资本、女性社会地位和人口统计的影响：来自伊拉克伊斯兰国（ISIS）的证据
articles.abstract_en: I analyze the impact of the religious fundamentalists’ rule on regional human capital development and women's social status by exploiting the unexpected rise and fall of Islamic State of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) in northwestern Iraq (2014∼2017). I find a large downward impact of exposure to ISIS rule on female human capital and an upward one on fertility rate for women who were school-aged at the time of ISIS occupation. These women express more patriarchal family norms and are more likely to belong to a polygamous union, implying a decline in women's social status. This decline in human capital and the rise of patriarchal family norms doesn't cause a significant negative impact on the development of their pre-school-aged children, possibly implying that these women didn't decrease parenting effort for their children. In summary, even a brief period of extremist rule has potentially large impacts on human capital development and culture.
articles.abstract_cn: 我利用伊拉克西北部伊斯兰国（ISIS）的意外兴起与衰落（2014年至2017年），分析了宗教原教旨主义统治对区域人力资本发展和女性社会地位的影响。我发现，对于在ISIS占领期间处于学龄期的女性，接触ISIS统治对其人力资本产生了显著的负面影响，并提高了其生育率。这些女性表现出更多的父权制家庭规范，且更可能属于一夫多妻制婚姻，这表明女性社会地位下降。这种人力资本的下降和父权制家庭规范的兴起并未对其学龄前儿童的发展产生显著的负面影响，这可能意味着这些女性并未减少对子女的养育投入。总之，即使是短暂的极端主义统治也可能对人力资本发展和文化产生重大影响。

articles.title_en: Calibration and validation of macroeconomic simulation models by statistical causal search
articles.title_cn: 宏观经济模拟模型的统计因果搜索校准与验证
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a general procedure for macroeconomic models’ calibration and validation. Configurations of parameters are selected on the basis of a loss function involving a distance between model-derived structural coefficients and their empirical counterparts. These, in both cases, are locally identified by exploiting non-Gaussianity in a structural vector autoregressive framework under a data-driven approach. We use model confidence set to account for the uncertainty in the selection procedure. We provide a measure of validation by comparing (model’s and empirical) shocks-variables structure. We apply our procedure to a complex macroeconomic simulation model that studies the link between climate change and economic growth.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们介绍了一种用于宏观经济模型校准和验证的通用程序。参数配置的选择基于损失函数，该函数涉及模型推导的结构系数与其经验对应物之间的距离。在这两种情况下，通过利用结构向量自回归框架中的非高斯性，在数据驱动方法下局部识别这些系数。我们使用模型置信集来解释选择过程中的不确定性。我们通过比较（模型的和经验的）冲击-变量结构来提供验证度量。我们将我们的程序应用于一个复杂的宏观经济模拟模型，该模型研究气候变化与经济增长之间的联系。

articles.title_en: Territory flows and trade flows between 1870 and 2008
articles.title_cn: 1870年至2008年间的领土流动与贸易流动
articles.abstract_en: Countries gain and lose territories over time, generating territory flows that represent the transfer of territorial sovereignty. Countries also export and import goods, creating trade flows that represent the transfer of merchandise ownership. We find a substitution between these two international flows during the years 1870 and 2008; that is, country pairs with greater trade flows have smaller territory flows. This indicates how international trade enhances international security: reciprocal goods transactions discourage irreciprocal territorial exchanges.
articles.abstract_cn: 国家随时间获得和失去领土，产生代表领土主权转移的领土流动。国家也出口和进口商品，创造代表商品所有权转移的贸易流动。我们发现，在1870年至2008年间，这两种国际流动之间存在替代关系；也就是说，贸易流动较大的国家对，其领土流动较小。这表明国际贸易如何增强国际安全：互惠的商品交易抑制了非互惠的领土交换。

articles.title_en: How to increase and sustain cooperation in public goods games: Conditional commitments via a mediator
articles.title_cn: 如何提高并维持公共品博弈中的合作：通过调解人的条件承诺
articles.abstract_en: Conditional commitment devices, such as price-matching guarantees, legal agreements, and smart contracts, can significantly enhance cooperation and improve outcomes in various scenarios. Despite their potential, empirical evidence of their effectiveness in the context of public goods is limited. This paper addresses this gap by demonstrating that conditional and binding commitments can indeed increase voluntary contributions to public goods. We begin by theoretically analyzing the impact of conditional commitments managed by a mediator on public good contributions. Our analysis shows that conditional commitments can be structured to achieve a Pareto Optimal Nash Equilibrium (PONE). We then validate our theoretical findings with laboratory experiments. The results reveal that when a PONE exists, nearly all participant groups adopt conditional commitments and achieve high levels of sustained cooperation. Conversely, when conditional commitments lead to socially inefficient outcomes, their use declines and cooperation levels drop significantly.
articles.abstract_cn: 条件承诺机制，如价格匹配保证、法律协议和智能合约，可以在各种场景中显著增强合作并改善结果。尽管其潜力巨大，但在公共品背景下其有效性的经验证据仍然有限。本文通过证明条件性和约束性承诺确实能增加对公共品的自愿贡献来填补这一空白。我们首先从理论上分析由调解人管理的条件承诺对公共品贡献的影响。我们的分析表明，条件承诺可以被设计为实现帕累托最优纳什均衡（PONE）。随后，我们通过实验室实验验证了我们的理论发现。结果显示，当PONE存在时，几乎所有参与者群体都采用条件承诺并实现高水平的持续合作。相反，当条件承诺导致社会低效结果时，其使用率下降，合作水平显著降低。

articles.title_en: Conflict, institutions, and economic behavior: Legacies of the Cambodian genocide
articles.title_cn: 冲突、制度与经济行为：柬埔寨种族灭绝的遗产
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores whether the Cambodian genocide under the Pol Pot regime (1975–1979) altered people’s post-conflict behaviors through institutional changes. We compare couples who had their first child during and right after the Pol Pot era. These two couples had distinct institutional experiences: The former were controlled as family organizations – state-owned spouses and children – and the latter were not. Combining spatial genocide data and the complete count Population Census microdata, we find adverse impacts of the genocide on parents’ subsequent investments in children’s education only for the former couples. We provide suggestive evidence that this can be because people were persistently susceptible to fear of violence depending on their experiences of the institutions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了波尔布特政权时期（1975-1979年）的柬埔寨种族灭绝是否通过制度变革改变了人们冲突后的行为。我们比较了在波尔布特时代期间及之后不久生育第一个孩子的夫妇。这两对夫妇有着截然不同的制度经历：前者被作为家庭组织控制——国家所有的配偶和子女——而后者则不然。结合空间种族灭绝数据和完整的人口普查微观数据，我们发现种族灭绝对父母随后对子女教育投资的不利影响仅存在于前一类夫妇中。我们提供的初步证据表明，这可能是因为人们根据其制度经历而持续易受暴力恐惧的影响。

articles.title_en: Springing forward and falling back on health: The effects of daylight saving time on acute myocardial infarction
articles.title_cn: 春季向前，秋季向后，健康受损：夏令时对急性心肌梗死的影响
articles.abstract_en: Daylight Saving Time (DST) is a common energy policy worldwide. We examine the effects of DST on the incidence of acute myocardial infarction (AMI) over three distinct time frames: short, medium, and long run. By exploiting the unique circumstances in Indiana, our findings highlight a substantial 27.2% increase in AMI admissions at the spring transition, which lasts for approximately two weeks, is not offset by counteractive reductions during the DST period, and occurs at each transition over the years studied, indicating little adaptation to time adjustments. Conversely, we find no similar effects at the autumn transitions. Together, these findings contribute to the ongoing policy debate by providing evidence of the short-term costs of time adjustments, without offering any discernible health benefits associated with the adoption of permanent DST.
articles.abstract_cn: 夏令时（DST）是全球普遍采用的能源政策。我们考察了夏令时对急性心肌梗死（AMI）发病率在短期、中期和长期三个不同时间框架内的影响。利用印第安纳州的独特情况，我们的研究结果凸显了春季转换时AMI入院人数显著增加27.2%，这种增加持续约两周，并未被夏令时期间的反向减少所抵消，并且在所研究的年份中每次转换时都会发生，表明对时间调整的适应性很小。相反，我们在秋季转换时未发现类似效应。总之，这些发现为持续的政策辩论提供了证据，表明时间调整的短期成本，而采用永久夏令时并未带来任何可察觉的健康益处。

articles.title_en: Does provincial gambling culture affect corporate innovation? Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 省级赌博文化是否影响企业创新？来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine the impact of provincial gambling culture on the local firms’ R&D expenditure. We find that local gambling culture, measured by the regional lottery sales revenue per capita, promotes local firms’ R&D expenditure. Further tests show that provincial gambling culture produces more innovation outcomes and results in high innovation quality in the long run. Our result is robust to endogeneity corrections using the instrumental variable and PSM-DiD approaches and controlling for firm fixed effects. The mechanism tests reveal that our main finding works through two channels to increase local firms’ risk-taking: hiring young CEOs and using more equity. In addition, we rule out the impact of neighbouring regional gambling culture on the local firms’ R&D investments by using geographic RDD analysis. Finally, our results are more pronounced for firms in provinces with high levels of social trustworthiness, more young ageing populations, and non-SOEs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了省级赌博文化对当地企业研发支出的影响。我们发现，以地区人均彩票销售收入衡量的当地赌博文化促进了当地企业的研发支出。进一步测试表明，省级赌博文化在长期内产生更多的创新成果，并带来高质量的创新。我们的结果在使用工具变量和PSM-DiD方法进行内生性修正以及控制企业固定效应后依然稳健。机制测试揭示，我们的主要发现通过两个渠道增加当地企业的风险承担：雇佣年轻CEO和使用更多股权。此外，我们通过地理断点回归分析排除了邻近地区赌博文化对当地企业研发投资的影响。最后，我们的结果在社会信任度高的省份、年轻老龄化人口较多的省份以及非国有企业中更为显著。

articles.title_en: Does family culture hamper corporate deceptive green behavior decision-making?
articles.title_cn: 家族文化是否会阻碍企业欺骗性绿色行为决策？
articles.abstract_en: Different categories of cultural traits have acknowledged that culture matters for a multiplicity of decisions made regarding economic outcomes. In response to the increasing awareness of cultural traits and their relationship to corporate sustainable behavior, this paper focused on one specific aspect of the relevance of culture: the association of family culture to green behaviors. This paper explored the nexus between family culture, the deceptive behavior of greenwashing, and firm performance in China, which provided original evidence that family culture firms have a significantly lower likelihood in participating in deceptive green behaviors as measured by greenwashing. By collecting the listed Chinese firms during 2011 to 2021, we estimated empirical models and drew a variety of conclusions accordingly. First, family culture firms have a negative and significant impact on greenwashing behaviors, leading to a decline in deceptive green production decision-making. Second, we further provided mechanisms which hamper family firms’ greenwashing behaviors into two perspectives: financial constraint and agency cost between shareholders and family managers. We recognized that financial constraints motivate family culture firms to greenwash, whereas the low agency cost related to family culture discourages family firms from greenwashing decision-making. Third, we provide very rich dimensions in discussion of heterogeneous effects. Specifically, within the internal family culture structure heterogeneities, family managers without overseas backgrounds, no generational or descendant involvement, and high family-controlled firms are even less involved in greenwashing decision-making. Moreover, with respect to external heterogeneities, family culture in pollution-intensive industries, highly regulated environmental firms, and Confucian social culture intensive regions, can significantly reduce greenwashing behaviors.
articles.abstract_cn: 不同类别的文化特征已经证实文化对涉及经济结果的多种决策具有重要性。鉴于对文化特征及其与企业可持续行为关系的日益关注，本文聚焦于文化相关性的一个特定方面：家族文化与绿色行为的关联。本文探讨了中国背景下家族文化、漂绿欺骗行为与企业绩效之间的关系，提供了原创性证据，表明家族文化企业参与欺骗性绿色行为（以漂绿衡量）的可能性显著较低。通过收集2011年至2021年间的中国上市公司样本，我们估计了实证模型并据此得出多种结论。首先，家族文化企业对漂绿行为具有负向且显著的影响，导致欺骗性绿色生产决策的减少。其次，我们进一步从两个角度提供了抑制家族企业漂绿行为的机制：财务约束以及股东与家族管理者之间的代理成本。我们认识到，财务约束促使家族文化企业进行漂绿，而与家族文化相关的低代理成本则抑制家族企业做出漂绿决策。第三，我们在异质性效应的讨论中提供了非常丰富的维度。具体而言，在家族文化内部结构异质性方面，没有海外背景的家族管理者、没有代际或后代参与以及高家族控制的企业更少参与漂绿决策。此外，就外部异质性而言，污染密集型行业、环境监管严格的企业以及儒家社会文化浓厚的地区中的家族文化，能够显著减少漂绿行为。

articles.title_en: The role of housing market and credit on household consumption dynamics: Evidence from the OECD countries
articles.title_cn: 住房市场与信贷对家庭消费动态的作用：来自OECD国家的证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine how fluctuations in the house price–rent spread, which reflect shifts in expectations about future house price growth, impact household consumption while considering the role of credit constraints. A rise in the spread, indicating higher expected future house prices relative to rents, boosts household consumption and eases credit constraints. By incorporating a housing spread shock into a model of household decision-making with borrowing frictions, we analyze data from 28 OECD countries over 50 years. Our findings demonstrate that shocks to the housing spread provide a sustained stimulus to household consumption by enhancing expected future wealth and reducing borrowing frictions. In contrast, credit shocks lead to immediate but short-lived ‘boom–bust’ cycles. The combined effects of housing spread and credit shocks reveal significant asymmetries, particularly during crises. These results highlight the need for policies that jointly address credit conditions and household expectations to effectively stabilize the economy.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了房价-租金利差的波动（反映了对未来房价增长预期的变化）如何影响家庭消费，同时考虑了信贷约束的作用。利差的上升表明预期未来房价相对于租金更高，这会促进家庭消费并缓解信贷约束。通过将住房利差冲击纳入一个具有借贷摩擦的家庭决策模型中，我们分析了来自28个OECD国家、跨越50年的数据。我们的研究结果表明，住房利差冲击通过增强预期未来财富和减少借贷摩擦，为家庭消费提供了持续的刺激。相比之下，信贷冲击则导致即时但短暂的“繁荣-萧条”周期。住房利差与信贷冲击的联合效应显示出显著的不对称性，尤其是在危机期间。这些结果凸显了政策需要同时解决信贷条件和家庭预期，以有效稳定经济。

articles.title_en: What drives demand for loot boxes? An experimental study
articles.title_cn: 什么驱动了对战利品箱的需求？一项实验研究
articles.abstract_en: The market for video games is booming, with in-game purchases accounting for a substantial share of developers’ revenues. Policymakers and the general public alike are concerned that so-called “loot boxes” – lotteries that offer random rewards to be used in-game – induce consumers to overspend on video games. We provide experimental evidence suggesting that common design features of loot boxes (such as opaque odds and positively selected feedback) indeed induce overspending by inflating the belief of winning a prize. In combination, these features double the average willingness-to-pay for lotteries. Based on our findings, we argue for the need to regulate the design of loot boxes to protect consumers from overspending.
articles.abstract_cn: 电子游戏市场正在蓬勃发展，其中游戏内购买占开发商收入的很大一部分。政策制定者和公众都担心所谓的“战利品箱”——一种提供游戏内随机奖励的彩票——会诱导消费者在电子游戏上过度消费。我们提供的实验证据表明，战利品箱的常见设计特征（如不透明的赔率和正向选择的反馈）确实通过夸大赢得奖品的信念来诱导过度消费。这些特征结合起来，使彩票的平均支付意愿翻倍。基于我们的发现，我们主张需要监管战利品箱的设计，以保护消费者免受过度消费的影响。

articles.title_en: Allocators are more prosocial when affected agents can visually eavesdrop
articles.title_cn: 当受影响者能视觉窥视时，分配者更具亲社会性
articles.abstract_en: In these experiments, participants made binary choices in “dictator” games choosing distributions for themselves and others. All payoffs are initially hidden and can be clicked open using a mouse. To study the effect of social image on attention and choices, we used a novel screensharing technique: One of the participants receiving the chooser's allocation can observe the chooser's clicks, so they can see if the chooser is looking up what the impact will be on their own allocation (but they cannot observe the chooser's choices). This change in observability increases the possible impact of social image concerns on expressed social preferences. It increases the time choosers spend looking at the potential payoffs to the observer and makes their choices less selfish. This finding goes against the hypothesis of “willful ignorance” and suggests other behavioral influences.
articles.abstract_cn: 在这些实验中，参与者在“独裁者”游戏中做出二元选择，为自己和他人选择分配方案。所有收益最初都是隐藏的，可以用鼠标点击打开。为了研究社会形象对注意力和选择的影响，我们使用了一种新颖的屏幕共享技术：接受分配者分配的一名参与者可以观察分配者的点击，因此他们可以看到分配者是否在查看自己的分配将受到什么影响（但他们无法观察分配者的选择）。这种可观察性的变化增加了社会形象关切对表达的社会偏好的潜在影响。它增加了分配者花在查看观察者潜在收益上的时间，并使他们的选择不那么自私。这一发现与“故意无知”的假设相悖，并暗示了其他行为影响。

articles.title_en: Patient preferences and physician availability based on physician nativity and international medical school attendance
articles.title_cn: 基于医生出生地与国际医学院就读背景的患者偏好与医生可及性
articles.abstract_en: Roughly a quarter of physicians in the United States are either international medical graduates (IMGs) or foreign-born physicians (FBPs). We propose a theoretical model where patient preferences that disfavor IMGs/FBPs may result in these physicians offering better access to their services compared with non-IMGs/FBPs in equilibrium. We use data from two field experiments to test the predictions from the model: one concerning patient preferences and the other concerning physician availability. In the patient preferences field experiment, we find that patients strongly prefer physicians educated in the United States to IMGs by more than 2-to-1. In the physician availability field experiment, we find that US-born physicians generally have lower levels of availability including offering fewer appointments and longer wait times. These results may indicate a substantial underutilization of FBPs relative to US-born physicians and suggest that greater acceptance of IMGs/FBPs will improve access to healthcare in a system that is constrained by supply shortages.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国约有四分之一的医生是国际医学毕业生（IMGs）或外国出生的医生（FBPs）。我们提出了一个理论模型，其中不利于IMGs/FBPs的患者偏好可能导致这些医生在均衡中提供比非IMGs/FBPs更好的服务可及性。我们使用来自两个实地实验的数据来检验模型的预测：一个涉及患者偏好，另一个涉及医生可及性。在患者偏好实地实验中，我们发现患者强烈偏好在美国接受教育的医生，而非IMGs，比例超过2比1。在医生可及性实地实验中，我们发现美国出生的医生通常可及性较低，包括提供的预约更少和等待时间更长。这些结果可能表明，相对于美国出生的医生，FBPs存在大量未被充分利用的情况，并提示在供应短缺约束的医疗体系中，对IMGs/FBPs的更大接受度将改善医疗服务的可及性。

excluded_items.title_en: Corrigendum to “Gender disparities in the labor market during COVID-19 lockdowns: Evidence from online job postings and applications in China” [Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization 223 (2024), 199-215]
Hospital capacity reporting in Germany during Covid-19
